title.narrative: Enhancing data and capacity development resources to support UNCCD country Parties in national reporting and targeting of efforts to achieve Land Degradation Neutrality

description.narrative: 1. This project has a global impact on the technical data aspects of UNCCD reporting by the Parties. This includes the socioeconomic benefits incurred by 150 participants of the five workshops delivered through this project, 2000 beneficiaries of the upgraded tool, as well as the 197 country Parties (Please see more details under the Section ‘Core Indicators’ and under the M&E indicators). Consequently, the benefits that this project will generate will be manifested over the medium – to – long term due to Trends.Earth and PRAIS 4 interoperability and the broader capacity for monitoring and reporting that the project will realize (with benefits both directly to governments as well as to civil society groups and others involved in planning and implementation of measures to achieve LDN). 2. The project will generate economic benefits for governments obliged to report to the UNCCD on its core indicator on land cover, as the methods developed to assess land cover using freely available datasets will provide governments with a cost-effective way of meeting convention obligations. This could in future also be extended to reporting to other conventions that use land cover as a proxy for other indicators, e.g., Land Use, Land Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF), Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation (REDD) and habitat connectivity. 3. In addition, the use of improved information on changes in land cover and areas at risk of land degradation and desertification will enable governments to improve the targeting of interventions that address these problems through sustainable land management (SLM). SLM interventions are designed to generate multiple environmental and socio-economic benefits and poor communities in affected arid, semi-arid and sub-humid areas that are the focus on the UNCCD will thus benefit from improved land productivity, incomes and livelihoods.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
To provide improved spatial datasets for Parties, particularly small island developing states, and build an effective capacity development environment for national reporting using Trends.Earth.
